findings.mechanism: Read-modify-write on wallet balance without SELECT ... FOR UPDATE leads to lost updates under READ COMMITTED.
findings.remediation: Change wallet.debit to perform an atomic UPDATE ... SET balance = balance - :amount WHERE customer_id = :id, or use SELECT ... FOR UPDATE within a SERIALIZABLE transaction.
findings.arithmetic: 10 concurrent debits of 10.00 each on initial balance 100.00. Without locking, each reads 100 and writes 90, so final_balance can be as high as 90.00 (lost 9 updates). Correct final is 0.00.

prediction.condition: 10 concurrent debits of 10.00 on wallet starting at 100.00

findings.mechanism: Loop inserts one LineItem per item causing N+1 statements per request.
findings.remediation: Replace per‑item session.add with a bulk insert (e.g., session.bulk_save_objects or INSERT … VALUES …) to issue a single statement for all line items.
findings.arithmetic: For a request with 3 items, statements = 1 (order) + 3 (line items) = 4 queries. Thus queries_per_request = 4.
